title: 失去了你
status: 提示词 v27，空灵女声，已精简，待再生成
coreStatement: 这是一首写给分手时装得很稳的人、关于人已经不在之后流星、梦和爱的传说都失效的歌，希望听众感到剩下的都不算数，并记住「失去了你」。

metadata.genre: 原声吉他与簧风琴的华语忧伤情歌

prompts.label: Mureka 专属风格提示词（278 字符）
prompts.zh: 慢速华语忧郁情歌，B小调。原声吉他指弹，发闷，很少的下行低音。情绪低、暗，旋律到高点就往下落。72 BPM，4/4，拍子拖着走，留大空，没有弹跳。空灵女声，近距离，吐字清楚，声音轻、浮在气息上，无人声和声。主歌更轻。副歌高音仍然空灵，唱到顶点就轻轻落下，仍在同一小调。只用三件：吉他承担动机；簧风琴按住悬着的低和弦，不落回安稳的终点；小提琴只在副歌拉低而闷的下行长音。主歌只有吉他。预副歌簧风琴进入，更暗。副歌小提琴才进入。桥段只留簧风琴。最后一遍更沉，不加快。结尾吉他留一个悬着的低音。混音近，人声在中间，低频收着。避免欢快律动、明亮大调，以及突然转调。
prompts.en: A slow melancholy Mandarin ballad in B minor. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, muffled, with very few low descending notes. The mood stays low and dark, and the melody falls once it reaches a high point. 72 BPM, 4/4, the beat drags, with wide space between notes and no bounce. An ethereal female voice, close-miked, with clear diction; the tone is light and floats on the breath, with no harmony vocals. The verse is even lighter. Chorus high notes stay ethereal and fall gently from the peak, remaining in the same minor key. Only three instruments: guitar carries the motif; harmonium holds a suspended low chord and does not settle back to the stable home chord; violin plays a low, muted, descending long tone only in the chorus. The verse is guitar only. The pre-chorus brings in the harmonium and turns darker. The violin enters only in the chorus. The bridge keeps only the harmonium. The final chorus is heavier, without speeding up. At the end the guitar leaves one suspended low note. Close mix, vocal in the center, restrained low end. Avoid a cheerful groove, a bright major key, and a sudden key change.
